source_instrument: Sri Lanka Gazette Extraordinary No. 2494/47: Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026
source_quote_span: A person shall not import, transport, distribute, store, sell, offer for sale, expose or keep for sale or advertise, any food contained in a package or container, unless such package or container is labelled in accordance with these regulations:
rationale: Food manufacturer packaging retail food for general distribution post-commencement is subject to mandatory retail labelling under Regulation 3.
expected_obligations: Mandatory retail labelling in accordance with Gazette 2494/47
legal_notes: Verified source text: Regulation 3 general prohibition against selling or distributing packaged food without compliance with labelling regulations. Evaluation date 2026-08-01 is post-commencement (2026-07-01).

source_instrument: Sri Lanka Gazette Extraordinary No. 2494/47: Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026
source_quote_span: Provided that, these regulations shall not apply to- (a) any food packaged in the presence of the purchaser;
rationale: Food packaged in the presence of the purchaser is explicitly exempted from labelling requirements by Regulation 3 Proviso (a).
legal_notes: Verified source text: Regulation 3 Proviso (a) statutory exemption. Unresolved interpretation: Threshold definition of 'in the presence of the purchaser' for semi-prepackaged display items bagged immediately prior to sale.

source_instrument: Sri Lanka Gazette Extraordinary No. 2494/47: Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026
source_quote_span: business-to-business food products that are exempted from other labelling requirements in these regulations except the following mandatory labelling requirements- (i) common name (in either of the three languages); (ii) trade name (if applicable); (iii) net contents; (iv) date of manufacture; (v) date of expiry; (vi) batch number; (vii) manufacturer's name and address; (viii) distributor's name and address; (ix) country of origin in case of imported foods; and (x) a complete list of ingredients. Provided further that the statement "Not for retail sale" shall be printed on the label or affixed through a supplementary label of such business-to-business food products clearly and conspicuously in bold type and font size of not less than three millimetres (3 mm).
rationale: B2B food manufacturing for business-to-business market only triggers the 10 mandatory disclosures and the 'Not for retail sale' label requirement under Proviso (b).
legal_notes: Verified source text: Proviso (b) 10 mandatory items + bold >= 3 mm marking. Business profile has market.b2b_only=true, exempting it from retail labelling while activating affirmative B2B disclosure.

source_instrument: Sri Lanka Gazette Extraordinary No. 2494/47: Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026
source_quote_span: These regulations may be cited as the Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026 and shall come into operation on the 01st of July 2026.
rationale: As of the evaluation date (2026-05-01), the Food (Labelling and Advertising) Regulations 2026 have not yet commenced (commencement date: 2026-07-01), rendering the rule not applicable.
legal_notes: Verified source text: Statutory commencement date fixed at 01 July 2026. Pre-commencement evaluation must yield NOT_APPLICABLE with temporal status NOT_YET_IN_FORCE.
